verdict.rationale: Lithic documents auth-time fraud decisioning: Auth Rules can key on risk score, MCC, country and currency at program, account or card level. ASA lets you apply your own models to the live authorization stream. Shadow mode and backtesting let you tune rules before they affect outcomes. However, the evidence shows no dedicated suspicious-activity alerting (only generic webhooks/events) and no tooling to block or reissue compromised cards (only generic card creation and card-level rules). missing for 10: documented fraud/suspicious-activity alerts, card block/pause and reissue workflow for compromised cards, explicit network fraud score sourcing, independent corroboration.
